subject: history_social
notes: The kingdom of Aksum, in what is now northern Ethiopia, was a major trading power from the first to the seventh century CE.
Its rulers raised tall stone monuments called stelae, each carved from a single block of granite, probably to mark royal tombs.
One stele, about 24 meters tall and weighing roughly 160 tons, was carved in the fourth century CE.
In 1937, during Italy's occupation of Ethiopia, this stele was taken to Rome and re-erected there.
Italy agreed in 1947 to return the monument, but it remained in Rome for decades.
The stele was cut into three pieces and flown back to Ethiopia in 2005, and it was re-erected at Aksum in 2008.
stem: The student wants to emphasize how long the stele was absent from Aksum. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Italy took the stele to Rome in 1937 and agreed ten years later to return it to Ethiopia.
choices.B: The stele, which weighs roughly 160 tons, had to be cut into three pieces before it could be flown back to Ethiopia in 2005.
choices.C: Removed to Rome in 1937, the 24-meter stele did not stand again at Aksum until 2008, more than seventy years after it was taken.
choices.D: The stelae of Aksum, each carved from a single block of granite, were probably raised in the fourth century CE to mark the tombs of the kingdom's rulers.

explanation.why: To emphasize the length of the absence, the sentence must show when the stele left and when it was back in place, and ideally state the span between them. One choice gives 1937, 2008, and "more than seventy years." Choice A gives the departure and the promise to return it, but not the return itself, so the length of the absence is not shown.
explanation.A: Incorrect. It gives the removal and the 1947 agreement but never says when the stele actually returned, so the reader cannot see how long it was absent.
explanation.B: Incorrect. It describes the practical difficulty of moving the stele, not how long it was away.
explanation.C: Correct. It names the year it was taken, the year it stood again at Aksum, and the span between them.
explanation.D: Incorrect. It is background about the stelae in general and does not mention the removal at all.
